What does OccupancyNPV cost?

Professional is $290 per year for one authenticated seat. Per-Deal is $149 for one DealWorkspace. Live checkout is available on the pricing page.

These offers exist because tenant-rep brokers currently rebuild a workbook deal by deal. Face rent, a separate tab, and separate emails are the current method. OccupancyNPV is built so that a focused workflow for compare commercial lease economics — cash-flow and NPV without rebuilding the spreadsheet — is worth a bounded annual or per-deal amount. That is not a claim that anyone already pays these prices.

Professional annual access

$290 / year

Intended for tenant-rep and boutique CRE brokers who would use a focused comparison workspace across deals. Professional includes access to OccupancyNPV's lease comparison, NPV + sensitivity, and client summary workflow for OccupancyNPV access. It does not include a CRM or lease-administration suite.

Per-deal comparison report

$149 / deal

Intended for occasional use. Per-Deal includes one DealWorkspace. It does not include unlimited seats, a start free trial, or extra seats.

Primary offer · paid-first

Professional

For tenant-rep brokers and teams who compare lease economics regularly.

$290/year

What you get

  • Ongoing DealWorkspace access while the Professional entitlement remains ACTIVE
  • Lease comparison workflow for cash-flow and occupancy cost
  • NPV and sensitivity analysis
  • Saved deal history in the authenticated workspace
  • In-workspace client summary for tenant-rep conversations

Value: finish one real lease comparison in the product instead of rebuilding a workbook.

Limits

  • One authenticated user. Additional seats are not included.
  • No CRM, lease administration, export, or public share link.
  • Trial is OFF. No free recurring access. No automatic billing conversion.
  • Cancellation stops future renewal; access continues through the paid period. Refund rules are in the Terms of Service.

What happens next: Start Professional opens authenticated checkout for $290/year, then fulfillment grants Professional access.

Secondary purchase path

Per-Deal

For a single active lease comparison. $149 per deal. Includes one DealWorkspace, complete lease comparison, NPV / cash-flow analysis, and result review. The first successful DealWorkspace allocation consumes the entitlement.

Offer type: paid-first. Post-offer price is the same listed price. Request Pilot Access remains available as an assisted secondary path, not the primary offer.

Why these offers exist

These are the current OccupancyNPV offers. Professional is $290 per year. Per-Deal is $149 per deal. Checkout starts from the pricing page.

Who should not use it

Who is this not for: not for landlords, not for property managers, and not for teams that need enterprise lease admin. It is also not for anyone who expects a CRM or lease-administration suite or believes a lower NPV is automatically the better lease.

Who is this not for

who is this not for: this workflow is not for landlords running a portfolio, not for property managers administering occupied buildings, and not for teams that need a full brokerage suite. It is also not for anyone who wants a CRM or lease-administration suite.

Objections worth answering now

OccupancyNPV is a working product. Live checkout is available on the pricing page. A lower NPV is not automatically the better occupancy choice. Sample figures are illustrative and are not customer results.

Does OccupancyNPV exist as a working product?

Yes. OccupancyNPV is a live lease comparison and NPV workspace. Public rollout remains controlled.

Can I purchase OccupancyNPV?

Yes. Professional is $290 per year and Per-Deal is $149 per deal. Checkout is available on this page.
